epoch_definition: One complete continuous native0.4s reference joint-trajectory forward/backward pass plus one actual Adam update. Pilot updates do not count toward300.
objective: Joint-angle trajectory MSE(rad²) plus lambda*mean(actual fractional neural parameter change from pre-BPTT manually tuned baseline squared); no u target loss
scope: Full3988-cell hard-forward surrogate HH BPTT on all485045 real signed edges; no outer spike replay. Shared207 variables on manual parameter bank. Exact native AB forward with white-box analytic/implicit physical BPTT; body/auxiliary schedules frozen.
contact_derivative_backend: white-box implicit contact derivative evaluated at native constraint acceleration; muscle/rigid/contact derivatives in patched MJX
physical_forward: exact original native MuJoCo3.3.2 with complete AB state and auxiliary schedule

historical_checkpoint_comparison.initial_checkpoint_archive_role: comparison only; not an optimization input
